mechanics.claim: Requires an enemy champion already affected by Dream-Laden Bough (Dream Dust) to cast.
mechanics.quote: An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} is required to cast this ability.

mechanics.claim: The bonus magic damage triggers only on the next non-persistent damage instance the sleeping target takes from a champion, large monster, or turret, consuming the debuff.
mechanics.quote: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage that a {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target takes from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} consumes the debuff to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The extra damage is attributed to Lillia and scales with her magic penetration.
mechanics.quote: The additional {{as|magic damage}} dealt is accredited to '''Lillia''' and benefits from her {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not prevent falling asleep or block the wake-up damage, but does block the drowsy application.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent falling {{tip|sleep|asleep}} nor block the wake-up damage.

mechanics.claim: Lillia can move during the cast time of Lilting Lullaby.
mechanics.quote: '''Lillia''' can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.

mechanics.claim: The lullaby's initial slow on drowsy targets is 10%.
